body.heading: Who owns Jersey Mike's now?
body.text: Jersey Mike's is majority-owned by the investment firm Blackstone. Blackstone agreed in late 2024 to take a majority ownership position in a deal reported at roughly $8 billion, and the acquisition completed in 2025. Founder Peter Cancro kept a significant stake and continues to run the company as CEO.

body.heading: The brand's roots
body.text: Jersey Mike's goes back to 1956, when the original sub shop opened in Point Pleasant, New Jersey. Peter Cancro started working there as a teenager and bought the shop in 1975 at just 17. He grew it into a nationwide franchise known for sandwiches made 'Mike's Way'.

body.heading: What Blackstone ownership means
body.text: Blackstone's majority stake is aimed at funding Jersey Mike's continued growth. With Cancro staying on as CEO, the brand keeps its leadership and identity while gaining the backing of a major investment firm. Most Jersey Mike's locations are run by franchisees.

faqs.a: Yes. Blackstone took a majority ownership position in Jersey Mike's in a deal reported at about $8 billion that completed in 2025. Founder Peter Cancro stayed on as CEO with a continued stake.
The original shop opened in 1956 in Point Pleasant, New Jersey. Peter Cancro bought it in 1975 at age 17 and built it into the national chain.
No. Jersey Mike's is privately held, now majority-owned by Blackstone. It does not trade on a stock exchange.
